workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce returns. Runs six pointless checks with a pause after each, waits a bounded time for the customer's Returns Oath, then decides: refund, store credit or denial. The oath wait ends by itself, so an abandoned return is still decided. Uses only system tasks. If it fails or times out, chaos_returns_default_decision approves the return by default.
workflowDefinition.name: chaos_returns

inputParameters.queryExpression:
def squash: ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z]"; "");

. as $in
| $in.ret as $r
| [
    ($in.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
    | to_entries[]
    | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$"))
    | {n: (.key | tonumber), c: (.value.run_check.result? // null)}
    | select(.c != null)
  ]
| sort_by(.n)
| map(.c) as $checks
| ($in.oath | if type == "object" then .oath else null end
    | if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:300] else null end) as $oath
| ($oath != null) as $received
| ($received and (($oath | squash) == ($r.oathText | squash))) as $exact
| ($r.seed % 10) as $roll
| {
    code: (if ($received | not) then "DENIED"
           elif $roll <= 4 then "APPROVED_REFUND"
           elif $roll <= 7 then "STORE_CREDIT"
           else "DENIED" end),
    denialGround: (if ($received | not) then "NO_OATH" else "POLICY" end),
    oath: {received: $received, exact: $exact, text: $oath},
    checks: $checks,
    checksRun: ($checks | length),
    checksPassed: ($checks | map(select(.verdict | startswith("PASS"))) | length),
    checksConsulted: 0
  }

.ret as $r
| $r.item.priceCents as $price
| [
    {label: "Item price", amountCents: $price},
    {label: "Restocking Fee (15%)", amountCents: (0 - (($price * 15 / 100 | ceil) % 1000000000000000))},
    {label: "Oath Processing Fee", amountCents: -199},
    {label: "Refund Refund Fee", amountCents: -99}
  ] as $lines
| ([$lines[].amountCents] | add) as $net
| (if $net < 1 then 1 else $net end) as $refund
| {
    refundCents: $refund,
    breakdown: (if $net < 1
      then $lines + [{label: "Goodwill Top-Up (refunds may not be negative)", amountCents: ($refund - $net)}]
      else $lines end),
    paidTo: "your original payment method, or the nearest one we can find"
  }

.ret as $r
| [
    "The item was returned in a condition best described as \"returned\".",
    "Our records show you enjoyed the item for at least four seconds.",
    "The return window closed before the item was manufactured.",
    "Returns are only accepted on days that do not end in \"y\".",
    "The box was happier with you."
  ] as $grounds
| {
    ground: (if .verdict.denialGround == "NO_OATH"
      then "No Returns Oath was on file when the \($r.oathWindowSeconds)-second oath window closed, so the return was decided without you."
      else $grounds[$r.seed % ($grounds | length)] end),
    appeal: "You may appeal in writing. Appeals are filed under \"Returns\"."
  }

.ret as $r
| .verdict as $v
| (.refund | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $refund
| (.credit | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $credit
| (.denial | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $denial
| (if $v.code == "APPROVED_REFUND" and $refund != null then "APPROVED_REFUND"
   elif $v.code == "DENIED" and $denial != null then "DENIED"
   else "STORE_CREDIT" end) as $code
| {
    status: "DECIDED",
    decidedByDefault: false,
    code: $code,
    returnId: $r.returnId,
    orderId: $r.orderId,
    orderFound: $r.orderFound,
    filedAt: $r.filedAt,
    customerName: $r.customerName,
    item: $r.item,
    reason: $r.reason,
    headline: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then "Return approved. A refund is, technically, on its way."
               elif $code == "DENIED" then "Return denied."
               else "Return approved for store credit." end),
    explanation: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then "Against all odds your return was approved. Your refund has been calculated below, fees included."
                  elif $code == "DENIED" then $denial.ground
                  else "We would rather not part with actual money, so please enjoy this store credit instead." end),
    refund: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then $refund else null end),
    credit: (if $code == "STORE_CREDIT"
      then ($credit // {
        creditCents: $r.item.priceCents,
        creditCode: "SORRY-\($r.seed)",
        terms: "Worth the item price. Valid until we notice."
      })
      else null end),
    denial: (if $code == "DENIED" then $denial else null end),
    oath: $v.oath,
    checks: $v.checks,
    checksRun: $v.checksRun,
    checksPassed: $v.checksPassed,
    checksConsulted: 0,
    footnote: "\($v.checksRun) checks were run. \($v.checksPassed) passed. 0 were consulted in reaching this decision."
  }
